description:
READ-ONLY: is there actually a usable backup OFF the server? Lists what is in the
    bucket for this database - the newest object, its size, how OLD it is, and whether that
    size matches the local dump of the same name - and returns one verdict:
    `ok` | `stale` | `size_mismatch` | `missing` | `unknown`.

    `unknown` is a refusal, not a soft pass: if rclone is too old, the remote is not
    configured, or the listing failed, this tool says so instead of inventing a verdict.
    Changes nothing on the box.
name: offsite_s3_status
